reasons: query1 drops the grouping: Datadog is avg by {db}, but the candidate emits avg(rate(...)) with no by (postgresql_database_name), so it aggregates across databases.

The $db and $host template variables (prefixes db and host, default *) should become postgresql_database_name=~"$db" and host_name=~"$host" matchers in all three queries. The candidate omits both, so the series set is wider than the Datadog request.

The metric mapping postgresql.rows_* to postgresql.tup_* is plausible (both count rows inserted/updated/deleted), and rate() on monotonic sums follows the convention. The outcome translated is appropriate.
